The template likely is a bromination substitution? The product SMILES is the second side: [O:1]=[N+:2]([O-:3])[c:4]1[cH:5][c:6]([Br:7])[c:8]2... So product contains nitro group and a bromine attached to aromatic carbon (c:6). The reactants include Br2 and the same aromatic nitro but with a hydrogen at that position (cH:6). So the template is bromination of aromatic nitro compound.

Thus applying this template in retrosynthesis to a target molecule will break a C-Br bond, giving precursors: the same aromatic nitro without Br (hydrogen) and Br2 (or maybe Br-?). The template likely expects Br2 as reagent.

Thus we need to apply template 1914398 to the given molecule (the product). What is the product?
